clientManage.title: Manage clients
clientManage.description: Add, edit, archive, or import clients from a CSV (e.g. export from Google Sheets). Sheets with columns שם and ת.ז: rows match existing clients by ת.ז (updates name) or create new ones. Optional id column (our UUID) still updates by primary key.
clientManage.name: Name
clientManage.csvHint: First row: headers must include שם or name (client name), and optionally ת.ז or tax_id (ID number). Optional id column = our client UUID for updates. Google Sheets: use שם and ת.ז columns; export as UTF-8 CSV (max 2 MB). Rows with ת.ז matching an existing client update that row; otherwise a new client is created.
clientManage.errorCsv: Upload a CSV file under 2 MB.
clientManage.errorCsvEmpty: No importable rows (need a שם or name column and at least one data row with a name).
